title: Crazing (steel strip)
visual_description: Network of fine, short, interconnected cracks on the strip surface; appears as low-contrast irregular dark lines over most of the patch.
inspection_guidance: Confirm under raking light; texture is easily confused with rolled-in scale at low contrast.
Check neighbouring strip sections for extent.

corrective_actions.text: Suggested follow-up: review rolling temperature and cooling logs for the affected coil (unverified).

source: NEU surface defect database (Song & Yan, Applied Surface Science 2013) — visual descriptions summarised from dataset documentation.

title: Inclusion (steel strip)
visual_description: Isolated or clustered dark spots/streaks caused by non-metallic particles embedded in the surface.
inspection_guidance: Measure the largest inclusion if a calibrated camera is available.
Distinguish from pitting: inclusions are embedded, pits are cavities.

corrective_actions.text: Suggested follow-up: sample the coil for metallographic inspection (unverified).

source: NEU surface defect database (Song & Yan, Applied Surface Science 2013) — visual descriptions summarised from dataset documentation.

title: Patches (steel strip)
visual_description: Irregular darker or lighter regions (blotches) of different surface appearance on the strip.
inspection_guidance: Verify that the patch is not an illumination artefact by re-imaging.

corrective_actions.text: Suggested follow-up: check descaling and lubrication conditions (unverified).

source: NEU surface defect database (Song & Yan, Applied Surface Science 2013) — visual descriptions summarised from dataset documentation.

title: Pitted surface (steel strip)
visual_description: Many small cavities/pits distributed over the surface, giving a speckled appearance.
inspection_guidance: Assess pit density per area if calibration is available.

corrective_actions.text: Suggested follow-up: review pickling process parameters (unverified).

source: NEU surface defect database (Song & Yan, Applied Surface Science 2013) — visual descriptions summarised from dataset documentation.

title: Rolled-in scale (steel strip)
visual_description: Oxide scale pressed into the surface during rolling; appears as irregular flaky dark marks.
inspection_guidance: Distinguish from crazing by the flake shape rather than crack network.

corrective_actions.text: Suggested follow-up: check descaler nozzle condition (unverified).

source: NEU surface defect database (Song & Yan, Applied Surface Science 2013) — visual descriptions summarised from dataset documentation.

title: Scratches (steel strip)
visual_description: Thin, long, straight or slightly curved bright/dark lines, usually along the rolling direction.
inspection_guidance: Record scratch length and orientation; repeated position across items suggests a contact source.

corrective_actions.text: Suggested follow-up: inspect rollers and guides in contact with the strip (unverified).

source: NEU surface defect database (Song & Yan, Applied Surface Science 2013) — visual descriptions summarised from dataset documentation.

title: Broken (large) — bottle
visual_description: Large missing or fractured region of the bottle rim/mouth.
inspection_guidance: Treat as safety-relevant; remove the item from the line.

corrective_actions.text: Suggested follow-up: check handling equipment upstream for impact points (unverified).

title: Broken (small) — bottle
visual_description: Small chip or fracture at the bottle rim.
inspection_guidance: Confirm visually; small chips may be under the localisation area threshold.

corrective_actions.text: Suggested follow-up: inspect for recurring chip position (unverified).

inspection_guidance: Often a feeding/orientation issue; part may be acceptable once re-oriented.
